name: LinkedRecordSnapshot
title: Linked record snapshot
description: What the linked record sent at the person's last refresh, on their Patient in a GA4GH pedigree, as a JSON string. Application bookkeeping, not clinical data: it lets the next refresh tell what changed in the record since.
